english.note: Use this when an influential or well-known person publicly lends authority or credibility to someone or something.

examples.english: This famous actor's endorsement of the brand immediately made more people trust the product.
examples.traditional: 呢位影帝親自為呢個品牌背書，產品即刻多人信。
